feature1.prompt: Allow ModelForm meta to specify formfield_callback by updating how the ModelForm metaclass handles this attribute. The ModelFormMetaclass should no longer search through the base classes for a formfield_callback. Instead, it must directly use the formfield_callback provided in the Meta class options. As a consequence, a ModelForm that specifies a custom formfield_callback in its Meta will have its fields constructed using that callback, for example ensuring that fields marked as required are handled appropriately.
feature1.hint_texts: Focus on modifying the ModelFormMetaclass in django/forms/models.py. Remove the loop which iterates over the base classes to find a formfield_callback and instead retrieve the callback directly from the Meta options (opts.formfield_callback). This change affects the __new__ method of ModelFormMetaclass and requires careful removal of redundant logic so that the callback specified in the Meta class is always honored.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/forms/models.py; Function: ModelFormMetaclass.__new__. Look around the block where the code previously iterated over the bases to find 'formfield_callback' (approximately lines 253-308 in the diff) and replace that logic with a direct assignment from opts.formfield_callback.

feature2.prompt: Allow ModelForm meta to specify formfield_callback by ensuring that the modelform_factory function correctly respects the Meta configuration. The modelform_factory must be modified so that it does not override the formfield_callback supplied in the Meta class of the form. With this change, a form produced by modelform_factory will apply the custom formfield_callback defined in its Meta, ensuring that behavior such as setting fields to be required is consistent between directly subclassed ModelForms and factory-generated forms. For example, when a custom formfield_callback is specified in the Meta of a base form, any form produced using modelform_factory should use that callback to construct its fields.
feature2.hint_texts: Focus on modifying the modelform_factory function in django/forms/models.py. Remove the explicit inclusion of 'formfield_callback' in the form_class_attrs dictionary so that the callback from the Meta class is used instead. The change should be applied around the section where the new form class is constructed, ensuring that no default or overridden callback interferes with the Meta-specified one.
feature2.entrypoint: File: django/forms/models.py; Function: modelform_factory. Begin by locating the block that creates the form_class_attrs (around line 636 in the diff) and remove the 'formfield_callback' key from that dictionary. Ensure that only the Meta class (which contains the formfield_callback) is used during form class construction.
